description: This file contains a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw data records to produce a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It aggregates costs by agent and a secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), filling in missing data with zeros to ensure consistent grouped datasets.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms a list of records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, organizing data by agent and a secondary grouping dimension, with optional sorting and label customization.
